topic: Supermetrics lets marketers create and edit campaigns on 6 ad platforms from a Claude chat, paused until a human approves (PPC Land, 3 Nov 2026)
instagram_caption:
AI assistants can now build your ad campaigns.

On 3 November, Supermetrics said marketers can create and edit campaigns on six ad platforms from inside a Claude chat: Google Ads, Meta, Microsoft Advertising, TikTok, LinkedIn and Snapchat. New campaigns stay paused until a person approves them, and teams can set approval rules per account. The company says more than 6,000 customers have used its Claude connector since February.

Why it matters: the gap between AI that recommends and AI that acts is closing fast. The bottleneck is no longer campaign setup. It's the rules you give the AI and the approval process around it.

What to do this week:
1. Write down who signs off on a campaign before it goes live, and what they check.
2. Put your naming conventions, budget caps and brand rules in one document an AI tool can follow.
3. Test an AI-built campaign on one low-risk account and compare it with a human build.

Let AI do the setup. Keep the go-live decision human.
